capabilities: Copy command lines from code blocks without selecting text
Strip prompts and output from clipboard contents
Apply default prompts per code block language
Highlight command line blocks with Prism
Normalize unnecessary whitespace in copied commands
disambiguation: Not a terminal or command runner; it only copies command lines from code blocks to the clipboard.
problem: Copying shell or PowerShell commands from Obsidian code blocks normally requires text selection and includes prompts and output that break terminal pasting.

relations.evidence: Optional syntax highlighting and styling using Prism Command Line.

summary: Command line code block enhancer that copies commands to the clipboard with prompts and output stripped for terminal pasting.
